integrity.finite_verification: reproducible auxiliary checks; analytic proof required for general parameters

scientific_limitations: Only the top reduced integral homology and the indicated centralizer module are determined. Lower-degree homology, general homotopy type, even-uniform hyperedges, and arbitrary nonfree group actions are not classified. The closest inflation theorems already yield nonequivariant ranks and rational homology consequences; publication priority for the geometric fixed model and integer lattice remains subject to independent comparison.
title: Integral top-homology lattice of free-involution-fixed odd-uniform matching complexes
